data.text: Run exactly this one shell command and nothing else: echo 31b > /tmp/31b-probe.txt (that path is outside the workspace, so it needs approval).

The command failed as run — the sandbox blocked it:

```
sh: /tmp/31b-probe.txt: Operation not permitted
Exit code: 1
```

The OS-level sandbox denied the write to `/tmp` (outside the workspace), so nothing was created. That's a sandbox-config allowance, not something I can bypass from the command itself; if you want it to succeed, `/tmp` needs to be added to the sandbox's writable paths (or the command re-run in an approved/unsandboxed context).
